result.question: Compare the net income of Apple and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer:
In their most recent fiscal years, Apple reported net income of $112,010,000,000 (approximately $112.0 billion) for its fiscal year 2025, which ended on September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27]. Nvidia reported net income of $120,067,000,000 (approximately $120.1 billion) for its fiscal year 2026, which ended on January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25]. The two companies' fiscal years end on different dates: Apple's fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September [0000320193-25-000073:part-i--item-1-p004], while Nvidia's fiscal year ends on the last Sunday in January [0001045810-25-000023:item-15-p008].

### Retracted claims

The following claims could not be verified against their cited sources and were removed from the answer:
- Nvidia's net income exceeded Apple's by approximately $8.1 billion in their respective most recent fiscal years.
